summary: Like (as in enjoy) pulls the thumb and middle finger together away from the chest, as if drawing something out of your heart.
handshape: Open hand closing to thumb and middle finger together (8 hand)
movement: Hand pulls away from the chest as the fingers close
steps: Place an open hand on your chest with the thumb and middle finger slightly extended.
Pull the hand away from your chest while bringing the thumb and middle finger together.
To say 'don't like,' do the same and then flick the fingers open away from you with a head shake.
mistakes: Closing the whole hand. Only the thumb and middle finger meet.

faq.q: Is this the same as 'like' meaning 'similar to'?
faq.a: No. That's SAME, with the Y handshape moving between two things. This LIKE means enjoy or be fond of.
